arabic text: BOHOT DOOR HOON TUMSE, ROZE PE BULALO
english translation text: I am very far from you—call me to your shrine.

arabic text:
SHIKWA BHI TUMHI SE HAI SHIKAYAT BHI TUMHI SE
HAR BAAT ME KEH SAKTA -NAHI MOLA KISI SE
EK BAAR TO ROZE PE BULALIJIE AQA
DIL GHAMSE BHARA HAI, TUMHE AAKAR ME SUNAWOO

DUNYA ME KAHAN TERE SIWA KOI SAHARA
JEETE JI AGAR DEKHA -NAHI ROZA TUMHARA
TO DOOR ME TUMSE NAHI REH PAAUNGA ZINDA
DIL GHAMSE BHARA HAI, TUMHE AAKAR ME SUNAWOO
english translation text:
Where in the world is there any support besides you?
If I do not behold your shrine while alive,
I will not be able to remain alive far from you.
My heart is filled with grief, and I wish to come and tell you.

arabic text:
RORO KE TERE ROZE KI JAALI KO BHIGOWU
CHOKAT KO TERI BAARAHA -ASHKON SE ME DHOWU
AY BAABE HAWIJ KARO ARMAAN YE PURA
DIL GHAMSE BHARA HAI, TUMHE AAKAR ME SUNAWOO
english translation text:
Weeping, I will soak the lattice of your shrine;
again and again I will wash your threshold with my tears.
O Gate of Needs, fulfil this longing.
My heart is filled with grief, and I wish to come and tell you.

arabic text:
DETA HON TUMHE WASTA ZAINAB KI RIDA KA
AUR SHAAME GHARIBAN ME -SAKINA KI SADA KA
SUNLO MERI FARYAD KO ABBAS KHUDARA
DIL GHAMSE BHARA HAI, TUMHE AAKAR ME SUNAWOO
english translation text:
I invoke before you Zainab's veil
and Sakina's cry upon the night of loneliness.
For God's sake, Abbas, hear my plea.
My heart is filled with grief, and I wish to come and tell you.

arabic text:
AY BAABE HAWAIJ TUMHE MOHSIN KI QASAM HAI
ABBAS TUMHE ASGHAR E -KAMSIN KI QASAM HAI
BAS DEDO MUJHE OWN O MOHAMAD KA HI SADQA
DIL GHAMSE BHARA HAI, TUMHE AAKAR ME SUNAWOO

AB WASTA US PEHLU SHIKASTA KA HAI TUMKO
AAKHIR ME BAS AB WASTA -ZAHRA KA HAI TUMKO
ROZE PE BULAKAR SUNO SALMAN SE NOHA
DIL GHAMSE BHARA HAI, TUMHE AAKAR ME SUNAWOO
english translation text:
O Abbas, I now invoke that broken side before you;
in the end, I invoke Zahra before you.
Call me to your shrine and hear "Salman's" lament.
My heart is filled with grief, and I wish to come and tell you.
